reviews.text: Very humane, animal-centered care, thank you very much! 🙏🕉️
They are very kind, they continue the examinations relatively quickly, but sometimes you have to wait because an urgent surgery comes in. This can be waited because every small animal deserves care.

I highly recommend it to everyone. The doctor and the assistant are both extremely kind and understand what they are doing. We took our cat for a laparoscopic spay, which I also recommend to everyone. We will definitely only go here, even though it is on the other side of town.
Super

I brought my 11-month-old female dog here for laparoscopic spaying, this was our first visit to the clinic. I booked the surgery by phone back in the summer, and I was given detailed information about the procedure even then. We went at 8 am, and by noon I had Lizi on her own two feet. This procedure is not at all comparable to the old surgical procedure, there is only one stitch on her belly. She was asleep by the afternoon, and it doesn't even look like she had the surgery today. Thank you for everything, I can only recommend Dr. Bubó's to everyone :)

We arrived for laparoscopic neutering with my female Jaffa cat. I requested an appointment 2 weeks in advance, we had to bring her in at 7 am without food. The early appointment was good, there was no time to demand food. We received all the information from the assistant accurately, we accepted the risk. (minimal). We came home, she called at 9:10 am to say that the cat had survived the surgery, was waking up nicely, and she also cut her nails during anesthesia as a courtesy. We could go after 11 am, but they only let her out fully awake. She was a little dazed that afternoon, but by evening she was already jumping on the furniture, running around. The next morning she was completely the same. No need for clothes or a collar, the wound is about 1.5 cm fresh. We are very satisfied with the care, I would describe it as professionalism, at an affordable price.

We went here with our two dogs for laparoscopic neutering. We were very satisfied with the doctor. He explained everything in detail: how the surgery would go, how long it would take, and how long the recovery would be. The office is very nice and well-equipped.

We took our cat to be spayed, of course we were worried, but Dr. Homoki very patiently explained what would happen. It was a laparoscopic procedure, and by the evening the lady was in good condition. After 2 weeks, the doctor removed only one stitch. I recommend it to everyone, they are correct!

I brought my one and a half year old border collie here for laparoscopic spaying in November 2025. I brought her here specifically because I didn't want her uterus to be removed during the surgery, as it could cause more complications in the long run. The nurse called me after the surgery to say that everything went well, and when I asked her directly, she said that her uterus had also been removed. I tried not to get upset that they didn't mention this when I went to them specifically to avoid it. When I met her in person, the doctor didn't really explain why he had removed it either. He brought up the idea of ​​avoiding uterine inflammation, but that doesn't happen after spaying, so I didn't get a proper professional answer. He also claimed that my dog ​​wouldn't have any problems with it, while I knew exactly that this wasn't entirely true. Now, eight months after the surgery, my dog ​​has developed incontinence, which, although a little early, fits perfectly with the pathology of incontinence after hysterectomy. Now I can medicate my incontinent dog for life, all because of a questionable, unfounded, old-fashioned "let's just get the uterus too" medical decision. There is no professional, well-founded justification or uterine symptoms listed on the spay form that would explain the doctor's decision.
I love this place, the Doctor is very professional. He saved our dog's life!

Our dear dachshund successfully sucked out a tick the other day, after visiting several veterinarians, they welcomed us this Saturday half an hour before closing, we are very grateful and thank you very much again! There are few endoscopic surgeries, but today we were able to return home relieved, thank you!

My 100kg Moszi/Kau dog was operated on by the Doctor. First, TPLO surgery was required on one, then the other hind leg. I searched for a suitable veterinarian for a long time before the first surgery, because it was important to me that the trust between me and my Hegyomlás-sized dog would remain after the surgery.
We received correct, helpful, very professional care. Thank you again to Axel and me.
We went to have our female German Shepherd spayed. We received a nice, polite welcome and very quick care for the dog.
Thorough examination and information. Correct doctor.

Our puppy received extremely thorough, conscientious and effective treatment, he was cured of a serious illness in a few days. We have been coming here for eight years, and so far we have only had similar, positive experiences. I can only recommend the professionally and personally excellent doctor and his kind assistant to everyone. Thank you for everything!
We took our little kitten to be neutered. Everything went smoothly and smoothly. The Dr. and the assistant were very nice.

I admit that I don't usually write negative reviews, but I can't help it now, I don't recommend this veterinary clinic to anyone.

We were here with our 8-month-old puppy because we wanted to get information about the laparoscopic surgery. When we went in, I explained why we came, and the information was that we would make an appointment, bring the dog here, and then we could come pick it up in about 2-3 hours. And they would have already booked the appointment, without any preliminary examination. Of course, I didn't expect a comprehensive examination, but I did expect that I would receive detailed information about the surgery, the preliminary steps, etc.…

I asked if the dog's breasts were swollen, because her heat had ended about 2 weeks ago. The doctor looked at her. I also asked her opinion about whether the dog was thin, because I'm unsure if I'm giving him the right amount of food, and I wanted to get a professional opinion while we were here. She didn't even look at him properly, she just said he wasn't thin. She didn't ask how many kg he weighed, nor did she weigh him. There's a scale in the waiting room for owners to weigh their animals...

The place is not nice, I didn't feel an ounce of trust in the doctor, I would never bring my dog ​​here, especially if there was a serious problem.

We had a laparoscopic neutering at the doctor's. Very professional, everything went well, they informed us about everything. They called us at the end of the surgery to say everything was fine. The assistant lady is also very cute and kind. We also received a gift after the surgery🤗
We went at 9 am, I was able to pick up our family member at 12:30👌
I recommend them to everyone!

Thank you!!!🤗
Gábor and Zigi the dog🐾
The best doctor I've ever dealt with. He's a friend to people and animals. He loves his job...a personal meeting would tell you more.
I have been going to them for a very long time. They are humane and truly adorable, 😘 Medically 5 stars, 🙏😘 …

The Doctor performed the laparoscopic neutering of our one-year-old dog. They were very kind and helpful when we made the appointment, along with the Assistant Lady. We received answers to all our questions. We arrived from the countryside and were half an hour late due to traffic. They treated us with understanding and flexibility, they did not send us away, and the surgery went smoothly. After three hours, we were able to go and get our dog Bodza, who was still a little dazed, but came out to the car on her own. It was reassuring to see how lovingly the Doctor treated her, and the clean, tidy environment that welcomed us. A big advantage of the clinic is that parking is free, and there are several dog walkers in the area, and you can also go to the nearby KÖKI with your dog. Since we arrived with two dogs, this made the wait much easier. The day after the surgery, our Bodza was just as cheerful and lively as before the surgery. Her sutures healed nicely, without complications. We wholeheartedly recommend the Clinic to everyone!
Expertise and kindness at the highest level. Thank you.
Patience, professionalism, kindness. I can recommend it to everyone.🙂🤩 …

We will be going here from now on! The Doctor is an extremely kind and very professional veterinarian! He performed a serious knee surgery on our German Shepherd dog, and we received detailed and understandable information about everything during the entire process. As soon as he finished the surgery, they called to say that everything went well, not to worry! After we brought the dog home, we were able to reach him both by phone and email from home, with our questions, which he answered patiently and helpfully! We are very satisfied with the care!
Great! Very honest doctor! Polite institute!

The doctor is a blood specialist, he couldn't be better, that's probably why he sees so many patients, which in turn leads to long waits and impatience. Everyone is right in their own way... Maybe if he worked with more doctors, they would progress faster.
MISERABLY SLOW
They have been caring for our dog for years, always friendly, attentive, and highly professional.

I recommend it to everyone from the bottom of my heart. Today we had 2 Yorkies undergo laparoscopic neutering and the doctor and assistant were both kind and attentive. They explained everything thoroughly and we got answers to everything. Oh and the cutting was almost nothing, so professional and grateful thanks ❤️

Over the years, we have been to many different clinics, but we have found a reassuring, attentive, and conscientious doctor here. We will definitely continue to come here. Everything has a price in today's world and a veterinarian is not cheap anywhere, but here we felt that the wallet was not the first thing, but the pets. Thank you. 🐶🐱❤

French bulldog, soft palate plastic surgery.

1. Failed
2. Correction, and didn't use anything.
That was 1 year ago...Never again 👏🏼
Very kind, attentive doctor

They are kind, professional, reasonable prices.
They will be talked about for generations to come!!
I highly recommend it.

Our dachshund had a tick stuck in his nose and we called about 10 clinics, but unfortunately they didn't have the equipment to take care of our dog. The doctor and his assistant were very kind and professionally removed the tick from his nose with an endoscope and sent the little patient home with painkillers and good advice. Thank you for the quick and professional care 🙂

I am very grateful to the Doctor and his Assistant, Gabi, for what they did for my cat. The Doctor took care of Tyrion outside of work hours, and even on his only day off, Sunday. I was able to leave the cat there knowing that I was completely safe, I knew that he would be watched over even during the whole day of infusion treatment, that he was in good hands, that he could hide under his blankets:) And I could go to him at any time during the day. I was able to take the cat in at 7 am, well before opening, so that he could receive the infusion as long as possible, so that he would get better. Anyone who is complaining and trying to dismiss the clinic because they went there and it was not open, and it was not open a second time either, has obviously read the announcement, where it is clearly stated that you should follow their website for daily current information. All up-to-date information can be found there. I think Best Vet:)

We arrived from the countryside with our 2-year-old maltipoo puppy, who was already in critical condition. The doctor was kind and helpful and found the cause of the illness and a cure that very day. We are grateful for the help, and we wholeheartedly recommend him to everyone!
We are absolutely satisfied. The doctor and the assistant are very kind and thanks to them our cat has been healthy ever since.
Bad diagnosis, bad attitude towards animals and people by the whole team!

We are very grateful for the professional care, not to mention the kind attitude! They performed a flat-faced neutering of our little yorkie dog through a small incision!!! + declawing and a tooth extraction! After 2 hours of treatment, he was already coming and going, playing... I can only recommend the clinic to everyone!!!!! We committed ourselves! Thank you

I have a thousand fish for Dr. Ur, we had an endoscopic treatment in March, (my dog ​​swallowed a sock in one go) we didn't have to wait long, they greeted us promptly, they were kind and did precise work. Thank you!😊 …

We tried to go for a check-up twice, and twice we were greeted by a paper posted on the wall about the closure for days. Their website says February holidays on the main page even in June, and they didn't even indicate the change in opening hours on Google, they probably thought that the information would reach more people from the paper posted on the wall...
Like most people, we didn't want to visit the vet just as a hobby, but because a problem needed to be solved. We went with high hopes, we gave it a second chance, but we were disappointed twice. Only those who just want to spend their free time with something should go, because they might find the clinic closed.

The greatest expertise resides here and it is also a mentality. I can only recommend the Dr., and the assistant is also fabulous. We had laparoscopic surgery, and we also went for minor examinations and vaccinations, they always welcomed us in a good mood, with the greatest expertise and kindness.
Competent doctor

Great specialist and the whole team is brilliant both professionally and personally. We had a laparoscopic spay with my 7 year old bitch, we brought Lenacska there around 5:00 PM and she was already laying in the garden the next day (because she is a yagd terrier), she was in no pain at all🐾 I can only recommend them to everyone!💖💞

The doctor was experienced, fast and accurate. We have been here twice so far, once to administer the combined vaccine, which is a complete torture for us, since the dog has received at least 4 vaccines so far and has become allergic to each one and as a result of a poorly cooked dinner, which caused a lot of stomach pain. When administering the combo vaccine, we arrived at the clinic knowing that he would be allergic again, so we prepared in advance. I wanted to administer the combo vaccine in separate doses to find out which one was causing the problem, but the doctor convinced me that it was unnecessary, so we tried a bunch of them. The dog didn't even notice when he received the shot and we just waited to see what would happen....and nothing happened, thank God the allergic reaction and anaphylactic shock were avoided. According to the doctor, it doesn't matter how the vaccine is administered. How right he was...and I would like to mention that the assistant lady is also incredibly kind and helpful. So far, this is the first place where we have only had positive experiences.
Wonderful Doctor and Assistant Woman. I bring my 3 Yorkies back to them from Ecser..

The doctor is super professional, he removed a polyp from my dear cat's ear, my cat can hear perfectly again, the assistant lady was also very kind, my cat received professional care, I can only recommend this clinic, I am grateful to the Dr.
Best doctor!!!

My middle-aged French bulldog had a laparoscopic surgery. The doctor did a brilliant job! He was a little groggy that day from the anesthesia, and the next day it was as if nothing had happened. The only thing that reminded me of the surgery was the very small scar with 1 stitch and the clipped fur on his belly.
And of course the assistant was also very nice, informative, in his slightly loud but entertaining style, in the best sense of the word!
If it's neutering, only Dr. Bubo! 🙂

I took my female cat to the clinic for laparoscopic spaying. I recommend it to everyone, it is a much gentler procedure than the traditional one! My cat was her usual playful self 1-2 days after the procedure, and the wound was a maximum of 1cm.
Everyone in the clinic is very kind, animal-friendly, I received accurate information about everything, there were no hidden costs. Thank you!

Very correct.
He understands the language of animals

I do not recommend this veterinary clinic to anyone, for the most part, mandatory vaccinations! He makes a diagnosis without an examination! Unfortunately, I only found out too late, my dog ​​died at his place! I was at his place last week, and he said the dog was not well, he had epilepsy-like symptoms, he was confused, his saliva was flowing, he was shaking occasionally. He pressed his spine, he said he had spinal pain, he had received a lot of injections. Let's take him back the next day. The next morning he had bloody diarrhea, I took him back in the afternoon, out of nowhere he diagnosed colon inflammation, he received a lot of injections again, let's take him back the next day. I took him back, the dog was still confused at times, he received a lot of injections again, and medicine to take home. The dog was not the real thing, 3 days later he had epileptic seizures, he had seizures several times, he was very, very sick. The clinic was supposed to open from 3 pm, it opened around 3:15 pm. I brought the dog in, sedated him, then took blood, which revealed that he had pancreatitis, he was in a life-threatening condition, I should leave him in the hospital because we can't do anything with him at home. I should go in at 10 the next day. We called that evening to say that the dog was there, he said he was waking up. We were excited for him, we had everything. I got to the clinic around 10:18, where he said with an unwavering face, "I don't have good news", SOMETIME he fell asleep at dawn.. And he didn't call... At 10:16 there was a missed call from him.. I ask, why not until then??? He didn't even look at the dog during the hospital treatment, it was cold in the office, the dog's mouth was full of blood, I suspect he choked on his own vomit 😭 No one should bring their dog here, especially not if hospital treatment becomes necessary, because no one will pay attention to him, he will be alone until the hospital opens! The doctor never smiles, he never had a kind touch towards the dog 😭😭 others should learn from my mistake!!

We took a female cat for laparoscopic spaying, we arrived at 10 am and were able to bring her home at 4:30 pm. Everyone was very nice and the cat tolerated it very well, the next day she continued to misbehave as if nothing had happened.

During the day, we urgently had to go with the Coby dogs, we called and they accepted us immediately.
Dr. Lajos has a great attitude, excellent communication and helpful skills.
He speaks straight Hungarian and not Latin like many graduated Buda "drs",
I can recommend him to everyone!
They are empathetic, they know what they are doing!
Thank you on behalf of my dog ​​Coby

Yesterday I had my cat (female) undergo laparoscopic neutering at the clinic, I looked it up online because I'm not from the district. We've never been here before, but I can write the most positive review, they're amazingly kind and caring. I took the cat in the morning, and in the afternoon, after she woke up and was under observation for a while, I was able to bring her back. The doctor did a very nice job, he performed the surgery on a tiny, tiny hole, thanks to which a day after the surgery my cat is running, jumping and moving just like before. The most gentle surgical technique that the doctor uses. I highly recommend it. The picture speaks for itself.

I took my sweet dog to have a laparoscopic neutering, and although it was still quite painful, the only small wound he had was practically gone after 10 days.
Thank you very much!

Whether it's monthly medication, annual vaccinations, physical complaints, or surgery, we come here and have never been disappointed with our dog. We thank the doctor and his assistant for their work.

They are very kind and helpful. I took my dog ​​to them for surgery, I got a much better price quote than anywhere else. They are very fair, I can only recommend them! :)
(it is worth going for an appointment, otherwise the waiting time is quite long - at least according to my experience so far)

We took our French bulldog for laparoscopic surgery this summer. Everything went well, I highly recommend it to any owner who is planning this type of surgery. ( Fast recovery, only 1 hole, which is now invisible, it is true that it costs more than a traditional neutering, but it is much gentler, and this is a big advantage. ) Thank you again. ♥️🐾🐾
Laparoscopic neutering 5 stars!!! Thank you!!
Reliable, correct and very good veterinarian
